description: Dual-rail pay-per-call market intelligence. FREE: /v1/track-record; cached $0.01: feed/snapshot/history/screener/route + /v1/korra/{calls,news,lean}; live desk $0.05. Same catalog on Base /v1/* and Solana /sol/v1/*. Descriptive market analysis only — not financial advice.

base.note: Live USDC x402 on Base. Paid /v1/* → HTTP 402. Free: /v1/track-record → 200 + IP rate limits. Cached $0.01: feed/snapshot/history/screener/route/korra/*.

solana.note: Parallel /sol/v1/* mirrors /v1/*. Track-record free on Sol; route/Korra $0.01 cached. Paid ExactSvm for paid routes; /sol/v1/feed paid-settle proven @ $0.01.

paid_settle.scope_note: Feed path paid-smoked; other /sol/v1/* share ExactSvm and return unpaid 402

same_price_rule: Identical USD list prices on Base and Solana. Only track-record is $0.00 on both rails. Cached $0.01: feed/snapshot/history/screener/route + korra/*. Live desk $0.05. HTTP 402 offer is authoritative.

virtuals_acp.settlement: USDC escrow on Base (ACP agent wallet), not the x402 payTos
virtuals_acp.pricing_note: ACP live offerings $0.05, matched to x402 live $0.05; ACP cached sentiment_snapshot and divergence_screener $0.01 escrow, matched to x402 GET /v1/snapshot @ $0.01.

free_funnel.note: HTTP 200, no wallet/x402 — track-record only. Route + Korra are now $0.01 cached (402 unpaid); Korra calls open_calls redacted; lean non-FEAR_GREED teaser. Mirrored on /sol/v1/*.
